canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Eira Coreth: 29-year-old man, 165 cm (medium), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: long narrow face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: hidden undercut. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
